long_biography.plain_text:
RMZ co-founder Manoj Menda used the 2020 sale of a large office portfolio to Brookfield to eliminate group debt and release capital for another development cycle. The company retained a broader real-estate platform, then formed joint ventures with CPP Investments to develop commercial office projects in Chennai and Hyderabad.

Menda now chairs RMZ’s supervisory board alongside Raj Menda. Non-family executives lead individual businesses, while he sets strategy, allocates capital and develops global client and investment relationships. Office property has remained the group’s largest development segment, supplemented by mixed-use, logistics, hospitality, residential and digital-infrastructure investments.
